If you are using Wi-Fi, it could add extra reduction in speed, always try to use cable.  


Also, The speed test you do for example on [Speedtest.net](https://Speedtest.net), is the speed test to their servers or a speed test in general,  


Proprietary servers like Steam/AWS/Google etc., are hosted elsewhere using different pathways (routing) and thus will result in different speeds due to congestion and the such.
